description: This Java class 'BaseQueueService' implements queue management functionalities such as saving, deleting, and retrieving queues within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with the QueueDao for database operations and handles events related to entity changes.

classes.name: BaseQueueService
classes.description: Service class for managing Queue entities, including CRUD operations, event publishing, and tenant-specific logic.

methods.name: saveQueue
methods.description: Validates and saves a Queue entity, then publishes a save event.

methods.name: deleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes a Queue by ID, handling constraint violations related to device profiles.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity, cast to Queue, by ID.

methods.name: findQueuesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all queues for a given tenant, considering system or isolated tenant context.

methods.name: findQueuesByTenantId (with PageLink)
methods.description: Retrieves paginated queues for a tenant.

methods.name: findQueueById
methods.description: Finds a queue by tenant ID and queue ID.

methods.name: findQueueByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a queue by tenant ID and queue name, considering system or isolated tenant context.

methods.name: findQueueByTenantIdAndNameInternal
methods.description: Finds a queue by tenant ID and name without context adjustment.

methods.name: deleteQueuesByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all queues associated with a tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity by tenant ID and entity ID, returns Optional.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity by tenant ID and entity ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is QUEUE.
